name: Orbit AI - Phase 4 - Client health/usage scoring (W4.1)

nodes.name: Every day at 6am
nodes.notes: 05 Section 9 names 'health/usage scoring' as a heading with no formula given - the actual weighting was undecided since the earliest pass of this library, blocking W4.1/W4.2 from being scaffolded at all. Built now per 06's 'left to Claude Code's judgment' framing for anything the source docs don't resolve - the formula below is this pass's own reasonable design, flagged as a judgment call throughout, not presented as brief-specified. Runs before referral-trigger.workflow.json (W4.3) would need engagementScore, and before tier-upgrade-signal.workflow.json (W4.2) needs currentTier/engagementScore.

nodes.name: Fetch LiveClient Companies
nodes.notes: Same query cx-cadence.workflow.json uses - post-sale scoring belongs on Company, per the load-bearing pre-sale/post-sale distinction every post-sale automation in this repo already follows.

nodes.name: Fetch active Contract
nodes.notes: Needs the Contract for tier + locationIds count - Company itself doesn't carry either. Runs once per Company (n8n's default per-item HTTP execution).

nodes.name: Update Company score
nodes.notes: engagementScore was already a field referral-trigger.workflow.json (W4.3) expected to exist but nothing wrote - this is what finally makes that workflow's filter mean something instead of matching zero rows forever. currentTier is written here too (not re-derived by every downstream consumer) so tier-upgrade-signal.workflow.json (W4.2) doesn't need a second Contract fetch.
